description: Crop an image to a region client and server side from freedailypro

format.description: The output format. One of: image/png, image/jpeg.

h.description: The height of the crop region, as a fraction of the image height (0 to 1).

w.description: The width of the crop region, as a fraction of the image width (0 to 1).

x.description: The left edge of the crop region, as a fraction of the image width (0 to 1).

y.description: The top edge of the crop region, as a fraction of the image height (0 to 1).

name: image_crop
